content:
I was trained using a mixture of licensed data, data created by human trainers, and publicly available information. This training included a very large variety of text sources, such as:

- Books
- Websites
- Wikipedia
- News articles
- Scientific papers
- Open source code and documentation
- Instructional materials
- Conversational dialogues

The data covers topics up to June 2024, and it contains a wide range of subjects, languages, and writing styles. No proprietary, confidential, or private data is included unless it is explicitly licensed for use.

If you have a specific subject in mind, feel free to ask whether my training covered it!
